disposition_reason: Three salt samples from salt fields in Losarang District were tested for Cd, Pb, Hg and As by AAS; all results are printed as below stated limits.

study.origin: salt fields in Cemara Kulon and Krimun villages, Losarang District, Indramayu Regency, Indonesia
study.market: not purchased; sampled at the salt fields
study.method: AAS at a commercial laboratory (PT. Sucofindo Cirebon); digestion not described
lod: not stated; results printed as Cd <0.008, Pb <0.041, Hg <0.0002, As <0.001 mg/kg
